name: Inter-dimensional mingling
source:
Find love in this sci-fi, western dating simulator! Take August or Hank on a date and explore who they are to know if you could be the piece missing in their life. Make a choice between taking them to Space or the Wild West for a date that will blow their socks off!

[from [url=https://proffessor-blue.itch.io/interdimensional-mingling]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在这个科幻的西方约会模拟器中寻找爱情！与奥古斯特或汉克约会，探索他们是谁，看看你是否是他们生活中缺失的一部分。做出选择，带他们去太空还是狂野西部，进行一次让他们大吃一惊的约会！

[来自[url=https://proffessor-blue.itch.io/interdimensional-mingling]Itch.io[/url]]
